name: Template-based map creation
description: Happy-path: A logged-in user opens their account panel on the map canvas, chooses "Make a map", selects "Create from template", browses template categories, previews the "Roadtrip Planner" template, clicks "Copy Map", watches a short copying progress modal, and then lands on the newly created map which is added to their list. Entry: user is signed in and on the main map canvas. Exit: a new map (copy of the Roadtrip Planner template) appears in the user's left-hand list and on the map canvas.
problem: User goal: Quickly create a new, pre-populated map (a roadtrip itinerary) without building it from scratch. The user expects to browse templates, preview content, copy the template, and immediately see the copied places and route on the map. Interface perspective: The UI provides an entry point in the user panel (Make a map), a creation menu (including 'Create from template'), a templates browser with categories, a template preview with a prominent 'Copy Map' action, and a short progress modal while places are duplicated. Result: User-perceived outcome — a ready-to-edit map titled/instanced from the chosen template with places and route visible; system-level outcome — a new map object is created in the user's account, template place records are duplicated into the new map, and the new map is listed in the user's map library.
